files_examined: scripts/clef_matcher.py (grep only: query_clef_engine, route_task, inkling model references)

findings.evidence: test_route_task_contract calls route_task("Fix pointer math in QueueHud hook detour", explicit_mod="queue_hud_src", log_telemetry=False) with no @patch on clef_matcher.query_clef_engine, while the offline and tie tests at lines 106-110 and 137-152 do patch it. clef_matcher.py:168 defines query_clef_engine(payload, timeout_sec=1.0) as a live daemon call. The assertions at 96-104 accept any engine in a set, so the test passes whether the live daemon answers or the fallback runs.
findings.suggested_investigation: Run `python3 -I scripts/test_clef_matcher.py` once with the clef daemon stopped and once with it running, and compare which engine branch executes. Check whether route_task's daemon path at clef_matcher.py:270-380 can hit the network with the 1.0s timeout. Consider whether the contract test should patch query_clef_engine to return None, as the offline test does, to make it deterministic.
findings.why_it_matters: The test's outcome depends on whether a local clef daemon is running at test time, so results can differ between machines and runs. It also means the unit suite can reach a live service, which the test-only rule does not expect. The contract check is still valid for either path, so the risk is nondeterminism rather than a silent pass.

notes: Assertion delta: 0 removed, 45 added, so no removed-assertion replacement check is needed. unittest.main() is the entry point and exits non-zero on failure by default, so failures still reach the exit code. Mock targets clef_matcher.query_clef_engine and route_task exist in clef_matcher.py (lines 168 and 270). The model name "inkling" used at lines 154 is present in clef_matcher.py at lines 221-351, so the assertion matches the code. Not verified: the body of route_task's tie/fallback logic (confidence floor 0.32 and role "review" at line 153) was not read, so that expected value is unconfirmed. TestClefDataset tests (lines 35-53) read the live ledger via extract_ledger_facts() and assert total_events > 0; that depends on a master ledger file existing, which I did not check, since clef_dataset.py was outside the callee allowance I used. No secrets were accessed.
